This course is very well organized and genuinely enjoyable to follow. The topics are presented in a clear progression, which makes it easier to build intuition about microfluidic systems while also understanding where and how they are used in real research and applications.

The term project is one of the strongest parts of the course. It allows students to explore a topic of interest in depth and apply what they have learned in a meaningful way. Working on the project really helps connect theory with current literature and practical considerations in the field.
